# Vallabh Kulkarni

> Associate Software Engineer specializing in Enterprise Automation, AI Engineering, Workato SDK Connectors, and Cloud Data Pipelines.

## Profile Summary
Vallabh Kulkarni is an Associate Software Engineer at OneSolve building mission-critical enterprise backend integrations, AI workflows, and data pipelines for Silicon Valley enterprise clients including Fastly and Dandy.

## Verified Key Engineering Metrics
- **-87% UKG Pipeline Runtime**: Query optimization & self-join restructuring.
- **25+ Hours/Month Maintenance Saved**: Delivered via 5 custom SDK connectors (Workato, SendBlue, LogiSense).
- **+30% Order Processing Speed**: Modular connector architecture across 40+ production recipes.
- **6 Major Production Releases**: Managed deployment, safeguards, rollback plans, and zero data loss.
- **4 Workato Certifications**: Technical Developer, Automation Pro I, II, III.
- **Academic & Algorithmic Excellence**: 9.05 / 10 CGPA from PCCOE Pune, 250+ LeetCode problems solved.

## Core Technical Stack
- **Languages**: Python, SQL, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML/CSS
- **Automation & Integrations**: Workato SDK Connectors, Salesforce (SFDC), LogiSense, NetSuite, REST APIs, Webhooks
- **AI & Data**: Gemini API, BigQuery, AWS S3 & IAM Roles, Deep Learning, MySQL
- **Developer Tools**: Git, Postman, VS Code, Next.js, Tailwind CSS
